answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The forge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the canyon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
